name: LONER_DOG://Snuff Puppy Carnage Society
source:
Argo works gas station night shifts. Maya humps a corpse. Haley is too high to care, she thinks. Roaches just vomited up blood. Can life just slow down? No? Okay, fuck me then. 

[From [url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/loner-dog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿爾戈在加油站值夜班。瑪雅正騎著一具屍體猛蹭。黑莉嗑得太嗨了，懶得在乎，她自己是這麼想的。小強剛吐了一口血。生活就不能慢一點嗎？不能？行，那我真是操了。
